name: MobileNet classifier (lightweight)
description: One class per patch, from a very small and fast network. For a machine without a strong graphics card, or for a quick first result. Starts from a network already trained on everyday photographs, so it learns from few examples.

settings.label: Epochs
settings.help: How many times the model sees every training image.

settings.label: Image size (px)
settings.help: Patches are resized to a square of this size. Larger keeps fine detail but is slower.

settings.label: Batch size
settings.help: Images per step. Lower it if the run fails with 'out of memory'.

settings.label: Learning rate
settings.help: How big each learning step is. The default suits most projects.
